name: Procentive

lifecycle.notes: Part of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands) portfolio

short_description: Behavioral health EHR and billing platform designed for community mental health centers, group practices, and multi-site organizations.
long_description: Procentive is a behavioral health EHR and practice management platform designed for larger mental health organizations including community mental health centers (CMHCs), group practices, and multi-site enterprises. Originally developed in Minnesota, Procentive specializes in the complex billing workflows common to community mental health including state Medicaid, managed care organizations, and multiple funding sources. The platform offers clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, claims management, eligibility verification, and reporting. Procentive is now part of Ensora Health, the rebranded Therapy Brands organization backed by KKR. Therapy Brands acquired Procentive as part of its strategy to build a comprehensive behavioral health technology portfolio. The platform is known for its strong billing and revenue cycle management capabilities, with features specifically designed for the reimbursement complexities of behavioral health including prior authorizations, concurrent reviews, and denial management. Procentive serves organizations across the Upper Midwest and nationally.
one_liner: The behavioral health EHR built for community mental health billing complexity.
best_for: Community mental health centers (CMHCs) with complex billing
Practices with heavy Medicaid and managed care billing
Groups needing strong revenue cycle management
not_for: Small private practices with straightforward billing

pricing.notes: Enterprise pricing based on organization size, provider count, and selected modules. Implementation fees apply. Multi-year contracts typical. Contact Procentive/Ensora Health for custom quote.

faqs.q: Is Procentive good for community mental health centers?
faqs.a: Yes, Procentive was specifically designed for CMHCs and larger behavioral health organizations with complex billing needs including state Medicaid, managed care, and multiple funding sources. It excels at billing complexity common to community mental health.

Procentive is part of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands), a behavioral health technology company backed by KKR private equity. The portfolio includes multiple behavioral health software products.

Procentive focuses on EHR and billing functionality. Telehealth capabilities may require integration with third-party solutions. Check with Procentive about current telehealth options within the Ensora Health portfolio.
